name: claim_admin_grid
xsql:
SELECT c.claim_id                                              AS claim_id,
       Nvl(c.participant_name, '')                             AS participant_name,
       c.employee_id                                           AS employee_id,
       Nvl(c.manager_name, '')                                 AS manager_name,
       c.period_name                                           AS period_name,
       c.order_code                                            AS order_code,
       c.item_code                                             AS item_code,
       Nvl(c.customer_name, '')                                AS customer_name,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(c.claim_amount, 0), '$#,###0.00')      AS claim_amount,
       Nvl(c.reason_code, '')                                  AS reason_code,
       c.status                                                AS status,
       Nvl(FormatDateTime(c.reviewed_date, 'dd MMM yyyy'), '')  AS reviewed_date,
       Nvl(c.reviewed_by, '')                                  AS reviewed_by,
       Nvl(c.uploaded_flag, 'N')                               AS uploaded_flag,
       Nvl(c.comments, '')                                     AS comments
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.status IN ('Approved', 'Uploaded')
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_period, '') = '' OR Nvl(:v_period, '') = 'All' OR c.period_name = :v_period )
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_status, '') = '' OR Nvl(:v_status, '') = 'All' OR c.status      = :v_status )
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_claim_search, '') = ''
         OR c.claim_id         LIKE Concat('%', Concat(:v_claim_search, '%'))
         OR c.participant_name LIKE Concat('%', Concat(:v_claim_search, '%'))
         OR c.order_code       LIKE Concat('%', Concat(:v_claim_search, '%')) )
ORDER BY c.reviewed_date, c.claim_id
